Windows 42/43 checks passed; one process emitted the correct pending JSON then exited 0xc0000409. Old harness did not retain stderr for abnormal exit. Temporary-image cleanup was suspected, not conclusively proven; bounded Windows cleanup and stderr diagnostics were added, followed by successful suite and 12-process pending repeatability check.
